title: Google is promoting a set of tools that let AI agents and developers pull its official documentation.
key_facts: The Developer Knowledge API is Google's official programmatic source for developer documentation on Google Cloud, Firebase, Android and more.
It serves fresh, Markdown-formatted documentation with semantic and keyword search and grounded Q&A.
The tool set includes a gcloud CLI surface, pre-installed in Cloud Shell.
An official Developer Knowledge agent skill connects AI coding assistants to the documentation.
The post also lists an interactive API Explorer and client libraries in several languages.
The post gives no launch date and no independent review.
quote_evidence: The Developer Knowledge API is Google's official, programmatic source of truth for developer documentation about Google Cloud, Firebase, Android, and more.
Designed specifically for modern AI agents, IDE extensions, and automated workflows, it replaces brittle web-scraping with a structured API that serves fresh, Markdown-formatted documentation.
why_it_matters_hint: AI coding tools that read current Google documentation can give more accurate answers for developers on Google's platforms.
notes: Full text read. Promotional post; no date.
